reporting-org.narrative: Foundation for Ageing and Inclusive Development

title.narrative: SCORE: Strengthening Civil Society for Older People’s Rights and Engagement - Year 2

description.narrative: The Strengthening Civil Society Response to Climate Change (SCORE) Programme is a multi-country initiative funded by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida) and implemented by HelpAge International in partnership with national civil society organisations across Africa and Asia. The programme aims to strengthen the capacity, leadership and influence of civil society organisations and organisations representing older people to promote inclusive governance, climate resilience, healthy ageing and accountability. Through Large Grants and Small Grants, SCORE supports evidence generation, policy advocacy, community engagement, organisational strengthening and partnerships to ensure that older people, particularly older women and other marginalised groups, are recognised as active agents of change and that their rights and priorities are reflected in national and local development policies and programmes.

participating-org.narrative: Foundation for Ageing and Inclusive Development - FAID

activity-date.narrative: The second year of SCORE implementation is started from 1 April 2026 and will end on 31 March 2027

recipient-country.narrative: The SCORE project is implemented by HelpAge International in 9 countries including Pakistan through anchor CSOs. In Pakistan FAID in anchor organization and responsible for 100% implementation in Palistan
